note.hint: I-Clarity ilapha: chofoza isithonjana semigqa ezansi kwesokudla.

note.migrated: Clarity: “Lungisa ivolumu” isibuyele lapho ubuyishiye khona. I-Clarity ngeke iphinde iyithinte.
now.cachedLow: Le ngoma isagcinwe kunqolobane ngekhwalithi ephansi. Ingoma elandelayo elayishwe kabusha izozwakala kangcono.
head.pick: Sekucishe kwaphela: tshela i-Clarity ukuthi lawa ma-headphone yiziphi.
hint.streamingFree: ngaphandle kwe-Premium, okuthi Phezulu kakhulu (320 kbps) kungcono kakhulu
hint.autoAdjust: yehlisa ikhwalithi buthule uma uxhumano lubuthakathaka
hint.gapless: uma kungenjalo ama-albhamu abukhoma azoba nezikhala

hp.noEq: Lolu hlobo lwe-Spotify alunayo i-Equalizer, ngakho akukwazi ukulungiswa.
